def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    markers = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 2)]
    # Extend each rectangle row along each side unless a marker is on that side.
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        left = any(rr == r and c < c0 for rr, c in markers)
        right = any(rr == r and c > c1 for rr, c in markers)
        if not left:
            for c in range(c0): out[r][c] = 2
        if not right:
            for c in range(c1 + 1, w): out[r][c] = 2
    # Extend each rectangle column above/below unless a marker aligns on that side.
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):

        below = any(cc == c and r > r1 for r, cc in markers)
        if not above:
            for r in range(r0): out[r][c] = 2
        if not below:
            for r in range(r1 + 1, h): out[r][c] = 2
    return out
